QuestInfo.name: [Attack on Titan] The City Falls
QuestInfo.0: The ground started to shake all of a sudden.
QuestInfo.1: You traveled to the Other World and landed on a house in a peaceful town. As you wondered how you should get down, the ground started shaking and people started screaming. You saw terrifying giants chasing people and... eating them?! You must run if you want to live!
QuestInfo.2: Well, you're on the ground now. Progress?
